name: Fixedvowelconsonantmirror

description_json.name: FixedVowelConsonantMirror
description_json.idea: A simple, highly reliable substitution cipher that mirrors vowels and consonants independently within their respective alphabets. Vowels are mirrored (A<->U, E<->O, I<->I). Consonants are mirrored within the 21-consonant alphabet (B<->Z, C<->Y, D<->X, F<->W, G<->V, H<->T, J<->S, K<->R, L<->Q, M<->P, N<->N). This is symmetric, case-preserving, and leaves non-alphabetic characters completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the plaintext:
1. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U, case-insensitive), map it using the symmetric vowel mirror: A<->U, E<->O, I<->I. Preserve the original case.
2. If it is a consonant (case-insensitive), map it using the symmetric consonant mirror: B<->Z, C<->Y, D<->X, F<->W, G<->V, H<->T, J<->S, K<->R, L<->Q, M<->P, N<->N. Preserve the original case.
3. If it is any other character (space, punctuation, digit), leave it unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: Since the mapping is completely symmetric, applying the encryption rules a second time to the ciphertext will perfectly reconstruct the original plaintext.

This is symmetric, case-preserving, and leaves non-alphabetic characters completely unchanged.

Cipher definition:
-encryption: For each character in the plaintext:
1. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U, case-insensitive), map it using the symmetric vowel mirror: A<->U, E<->O, I<->I. Preserve the original case.
2. If it is a consonant (case-insensitive), map it using the symmetric consonant mirror: B<->Z, C<->Y, D<->X, F<->W, G<->V, H<->T, J<->S, K<->R, L<->Q, M<->P, N<->N. Preserve the original case.
3. If it is any other character (space, punctuation, digit), leave it unchanged.
-decryption: Since the mapping is completely symmetric, applying the encryption rules a second time to the ciphertext will perfectly reconstruct the original plaintext.
